gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs its words dense and tall through the middle, with generous entrances into every letter's inner space. Mystery Quest's open-jawed curves give it a bookish, nostalgic lift.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-multani: Nostalgic open-jawed curves and compact ascenders define Mystery Quest, while Noto Sans Multani follows with a lofty x-height and a wide-gapped e. One looks backward; the other looks modern.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Mystery Quest's curved strokes all gape open, giving the heading a bookish, nostalgic face. And Noto Sans Myanmar settles into a thick, heavy-looking strip of text with a broadly welcoming c.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Noto Sans Nabataean reads with lowercase standing almost cap-tall. Mystery Quest does its best work as a display voice, bookish and nostalgic, while the body font handles continuous text with wide-open s curves.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-nag-munda: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads like a plain sans whose c and s look half unwrapped, with lowercase rivaling the capitals. But shrink Mystery Quest down small and its open-jawed, bookish curves lose their charm.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-nandinaga: Noto Sans Nandinagari reads as a friendly plain sans, short in the ascenders and large in the lowercase. And Mystery Quest brings the bookish, nostalgic display flair, while the body font keeps its openings generous at every weight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa reads as a plain sans with a clearly open mouth on its lowercase e and tall, spacious bowls. Mystery Quest does the nostalgic, bookish display work, and the body font handles the text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu reads with a towering x-height and terminals held far from the stroke body, which feels thoroughly modern. Over a full page, Noto Sans Nushu stays breezy while Mystery Quest keeps its bookish, nostalgic accent.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Solid blocks of words meet open-jawed curves here, clean against nostalgic. And Mystery Quest earns its keep when big and short, while Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds back the tails of its curves.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-old-hunga: Bookish curves up top, wide-open counters below. And Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps its tall a, e and s apertures open even at tiny sizes, so size it down freely beside Mystery Quest.
